results.question: Summarize Vertex AI's journey from founding to 2026
results.answer: Vertex AI was founded in 2020 by Dr. Rachel Kim and Mark Torres in Boston, MA, initially focusing on enterprise NLP. In 2021, they launched their first product, TextMind API, and secured a $5M seed round. By 2022, they pivoted to healthcare-specific AI after customer demand, raising $25M in Series A funding. In 2023, their clinical NLP platform, DiagnosText, achieved FDA 510(k) clearance, generating $8M in revenue. In 2024, they signed contracts with 30+ hospital systems, reaching $35M in revenue, but suffered a data breach exposing 12,000 patient records. In 2025, they completed a SOC 2 Type II audit, acquired MedSync Labs for $45M, and filed confidentially for an IPO. In February 2026, Vertex AI went public on NASDAQ at $32 per share, reaching a $6.5B market cap
